title: Lowest point speed
description: Essential: Correctly calculates speed at lowest point using tension and centripetal force.

title: Highest point speed
description: Essential: Correctly determines minimum speed at highest point using centripetal force condition.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem including gravity, air resistance, and kinetic energy changes.

title: Gravity work calculation
description: Important: Correctly accounts for gravitational potential energy change over full vertical circle.

title: Air resistance work sign
description: Important: Distinguishes between work done by air resistance and work done to overcome it.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and final answer.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Confuses work done by air resistance with work done against air resistance.

title: Incorrect centripetal condition
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong condition at highest point (e.g., tension ≠ 0 instead of minimum speed condition).
